Our biggest merchant, Cragsley Outfitters, grew sales +19.8% year-over-year this holiday quarter (vs. the same Oct-Dec period last year) - real growth, not just seasonal bump.
Castell Fasteners, one of our top 4 merchants, is flashing a warning sign: shopper traffic on its site dropped 44% this quarter and it's sitting on €5,080 in unpaid invoices.

Merchants with naturally recurring purchases (coffee/food subscriptions, B2B restocking) keep 83-94% of customers coming back, vs. ~58% for general retail - a strong case for building reorder habits into any merchant's playbook.
